title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode6 If There's A Limit

meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You're from RADder... What are you...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, drink this.
Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've been singing a lot around here lately, right? I've seen a few of your performances.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I have. And it's hard not to notice you since I can hear you from two streets over.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You also sing like you mean it, so your performances usually end up being memorable.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, I felt kind of concerned when I saw you sitting all by yourself with a look on your face like the world just ended.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm happy, but also feel so stupid...
This really isn't how I wanted to meet my hero.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I don't know what happened, but it's always good to talk to someone when you feel stuck.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Be it songs or worries, it's sometimes just best to spit it out.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(How can I...?
Me? Crying on someone's shoulder...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But I might be able to learn something from him. I mean, he's such an amazing singer...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (If he tells me to quit music like all the others... Then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I performed in an event at Crawl Green earlier today...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Now it makes sense.
You decided to perform there and they sorta ate you alive.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
So, do you regret what happened?
The look on your face says there's more to it than just that...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Yes, getting made fun of and performing so badly is so frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: But what bothers me the most is how I dragged that place's name through the mud. I can't forgive myself for doing that...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I was convinced that I could come back from any failures by working harder than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: But this is the result of all that...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I-I'm having trouble believing in myself now...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: A part of me is always telling me that I'm going to hit my ceiling...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I see...
So you can't forgive yourself for getting shaken the way you did.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Well, if you believe what that voice is telling you, sooner or later, you will reach your limit.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Fortunately, the solution's pretty simple. You just need to break through that ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's easy for your mind to fall into the trap of believing there's no more use in trying. That there's no light at the end of the tunnel.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, whenever you feel that way, don't listen to your mind. Listen to your heart. Follow it. Go after what gets your blood pumping.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Your body will tell you the answer. It'll tell you what you actually want to do.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's right. If you feel down and like everything's falling apart, but your body still wants to sing...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That means you shouldn't quit and singing is the only way you'll break through your ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You didn't quit today, right?
So, good job for making it through.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, you might want to not perform in events for a while. I have a feeling that your throat's desperate for a break since you've been practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you want to keep singing, you need to take a breather every so often. Anyway, see you around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. And I decided to keep singing because of what Ken said.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I made my decision. No matter what anyone says, I'm not quitting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be honest, every time I practice with Toya, An and Kohane... I'm reminded of how much work I still have left to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But I'm not gonna stop singing, no matter how tough things get...
Not until we surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: If you still have work to do, where does that leave me? Still... I get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, let's run for a little longer! We're gonna sing after that, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You seem pretty energized all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I mean, who wouldn't be after hearing a story like that?! It totally just gave me a second wind!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Especially since I wanna surpass RAD WEEKEND with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, huh...? What's everyone doing gathering up over there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, that's Punch Drink...
It's a new live house that just opened up. They might be doing an event or something.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Still, that's a ton of people... Who's performing? Oh, someone's walking out...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Thanks for coming to see us, everyone. It's nice to be back on Vivid Street after being away for so long.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: If you're willing to say that much, then come perform at the event at Crawl Green next week.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: We're gonna wipe that from your memories by going all out with our first song! Get ready to make some noise!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Uh, sure. Just give me one second. I'll try to get to you all one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Hey, why don't you guys come in a little closer... Hang on. Over there... Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Hey, Shinonome! Long time no see! How you been? You're still singing, right?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line:
With a new team too.
We heard that you guys have been putting on your own events.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
What...?!
Akito, the group from your story was Shepard...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I thought you guys left Vivid Street to sing elsewhere and sign with a major label! I didn't realize you were still doing shows around here...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician B
rows.Line: It's surprising to see you still singing after dragging Crawl Green's name through the mud the way you did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what I did was bad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was my fault for not having what it took to keep that crowd excited.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But things are different now...
Be it Crawl Green or wherever, I know how to get a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Oh? Feeling all high and mighty after grouping up with Tono, are we...?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Alright, Mr. Big Talk. Why don't you sing for us right here, right now?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: This is your chance to make up for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: A few years have passed since then. You standing here means you kept at it until now, right?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line:
Still, you're no match for us...
And you don't want to sing because you know that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Uh oh, this could be bad! What should I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's already this late...
I'll continue tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I guess Akito must have finished training by now. He might be taking Luka to see the illuminations.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll try contacting him in a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes!
Akito's about to fight someone on the street!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Actually, more like battle them. By singing!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I became worried after seeing that he was outnumbered and noticing how unsettling it all felt. Not only that, he seems to have some history with those people...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should also ask Shiraishi to let Ken know about what's happening just in case...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka, would you mind keeping an eye on Akito for me? We may not be able to get ahold of him as things are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay! I'll try letting An know if things do get serious!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No response...
Her dad's place will be busy at this time, so she may have her hands full.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Who else can I ask...?
Oh, Azusawa might be with her right now.

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
And talk about being lucky! We get to see them sing again right after their show♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They were good back then, but they've gotten even better...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess they kept on honing their craft while I worked my butt off.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oddly enough, I'm feeling more optimistic this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line:
Whew. Thanks, everyone!
Alright, Shinonome, you ready?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician C
rows.Line: This guy said he's gonna knock us outta the park.

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line:
Wait, all by himself...?
I thought he was gonna sing with his friend.

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line:
I feel kinda bad for him.
But I guess you reap what you sow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've been doing everything I possibly could until now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All so that we'll surpass RAD WEEKEND, together.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't care if you want to try stuff on your own, but we're surpassing RAD WEEKEND as a team, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's sing as a team, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, you're the best partner I could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They helped me every time I hit a wall.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We decided to aim for the top, together.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They've helped me improve way faster compared to when I was by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Say goodbye to the old me, and say hello to...!)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: Yeah, Shepard was amazing... But he's...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Where did he learn to sing like this...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They seem pretty warmed up, so let's kick it up a notch...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Back then, no matter how hard I tried, it felt like I couldn't get anywhere close to RAD WEEKEND. But now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm going toe to toe with guys of their caliber.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've long since broken through that ceiling...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I'm gonna sing all the way through until the end...!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: There's no doubt about it, Akito! You're the winner!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This never would've been possible back then.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Akito?! Was that you just now?! No wonder all these people are here! Expect nothing less from the guy trying to top RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! His opponents are also really good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh...? What did I feel just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I just redeemed myself a little after dragging a legendary live house's name through the mud... And showed how much I've grown by getting back at those guys...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Why did I feel satisfied after that...? I'm trying to accomplish something bigger, aren't I?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (For that... I have to aim higher than this! I have to get even better than I am now!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya, An and Kohane are miles ahead of me too! They would've put on a way better performance!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And Tono... This would've been a cakewalk for him.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They sang in a way that set everyone's hearts on fire. They made that place erupt... I have to learn how to do that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can't be satisfied with just this...)

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: What is it? If you got something to say, just say it...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Hey, Akito, wait! Where are you going?!
